decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 2 - The roof area of the extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The development shall not be occupied until screen planting along the northern boundary have been planted in accordance with a scheme submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.
Condition : 7 - The garage shall be retained and shall not be used to provide additional habitable living accommodation without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding any details pertaining to doors and windows shown on the submitted plans, drawings showing the detailed design of the doors and windows (including the front garage door) to scale 1:20 shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning authority before the development is commenced.  The development shall only be carried out in accordance with the details as may be subsequently approved.

Condition : 9 - Reasons
With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of a single storey wrap-around extension to the side and rear of the house together with an entrance porch canopy on the front elevation of the house, by reason of positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, are considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, site characteristics, the immediate local area and the conservation area.  The proposal would not be harmful to the character and appearance of the street scene or the Bedfont Green Conservation Area, or the amenities of the adjacent neighbouring properties.  The development is considered to be in accordance with the relevant provisions of Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), ENV-H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003), and the Residential Extension Guidelines 2002 and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Demolition of the existing garage and erection of single storey side and rear extension to house.
